title: Q-ROOT-area-decay: area-decay keeps recurring: Give the area an advocate loop with a cadence and a growth item per run; attention weights lift neglected areas in the executor queue.
body:
**Owner:** project-manager
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe area-decay
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `area-decay` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no loop owns the area's upkeep, so work stopped when the area's first burst ended
Guard: `grep:foundation/temporal.py::neglect`
Remedy: Give the area an advocate loop with a cadence and a growth item per run; attention weights lift neglected areas in the executor queue.
Symptoms seen:
- temporal:94167fdea6: area:business decay: 2 commits in 3 days after 37 in the 8 days before (4.6 a day)
- temporal:69713c50e8: area:docs decay: 5 commits in 3 days after 98 in the 8 days before (12.2 a day)
- inbox:business-and-docs-areas-decayed-after-th: business and docs areas decayed after their first burst
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe area-decay

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T16:31:48Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
